description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and MRR@10 for various DPR models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot compares six different DPR models: DPR w/o query (black, solid line), DPR w/ gold (yellow, solid line), DPR w/ top-1 (green, solid line), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple, dashed line), DPR w/ random (blue, dashed line), and DPR w/ curriculum (red, dashed line). The black line remains steady at approximately 34.4 across the x-axis. The yellow line starts at around 33.1 at x=1, decreases to 33.0 at x=2, and then increases to 35.0 at x=10. The green line begins at 33.1 at x=1, increases sharply to 35.7 at x=4, and continues to rise to 36.4 at x=10. The purple line starts at 34.7 at x=1, peaks at 35.1 at x=2, and then declines to 34.7 at x=10. The blue line begins at 34.7 at x=1, increases to 35.6 at x=4, and then decreases slightly to 35.3 at x=10. The red line starts at 35.4 at x=1, increases to 35.7 at x=2, and remains relatively steady around 35.7 across the x-axis.
